title: The One You Didn't See
hook: The one that was not in the wide shot.
scene: You have Gracie. She is pulled tight against you, tense and low, ears back, head turned into your arm, orange and cream. Across the lot the three are still far off and still not looking. This one was never in that shot. It is between the parked rows, already inside the space, and it comes. Mid-stride. The head is down and turned away. The frame ends there. It does not reach you. It does not reach her.
decision: It is coming. What do you do?

options.text: Put yourself between it and the cats
options.result: You turn your body so it has you and not her. Gracie is under your arm. The lunge stops at the edge of the frame. Nothing touches you. Nothing touches her. Mya is not in this picture. You acted. It does not change what the lot takes.

You take Gracie and you go. She is against you. The lunge is still coming when the frame cuts. Nothing touches you. Nothing touches her. You moved. The one that mattered was already closer than the three you were watching.

You freeze. That is what a person does. Gracie is under your hand. The lunge fills the near ground and the frame ends before it arrives. Nothing touches you. Nothing touches her. You did not choose this. You still get to have been here.

debrief: You had Gracie. The one that came was not one of the three. The frame ends before it reaches either of you.

source.teaching_target: The lunge, used once. Every option is an attempt, not a miss. Timeout is freeze. No grade, no retry, no contact.

image_brief.subject: shot from inside the aisle, slightly beside the runner, so the camera sees the back of the head and the driving shoulder — not a face-on charge. One filthy figure running hard between two derelict cars, one foot off the ground, body pitched forward. Near foreground is the back of an orange tabby's head against Ali's brown wrist and faded pink cuff
image_brief.foreground: the back of Gracie's head, ears flattened, orange fur, pulled tight against Ali's wrist. Ali is half African American: warm medium-brown skin on the wrist and hand, faded pink hoodie cuff, her face not in frame. The cat is not looking at the lens
image_brief.midground: rear three-quarter of a running figure about fifteen feet off, close, already in the aisle. We see the back of the skull and swinging hair, the face is on the far side of the head and is not in the shot. One foot off the ground, jacket and arms blurred by the run, parked cars sharp. Filthy torn clothing. No contact. Does not fill the frame
image_brief.background: two derelict parked cars framing the aisle left and right, wet asphalt, flat gray overcast, no other people
image_brief.read: the lunge is toward her and the frame ends there, Gracie is pulled tight against a pink sleeve, and the face is not looking at her
extra_negatives: no eye contact with the camera
no person looking at the lens
no blurred or pixelated face patch
the figure does not fill the frame
